label_rule.rule: List titles are stored as the party names printed in the decision. A party name containing a living person’s name is replaced by the abbreviation printed with it, or omitted; a list with no remaining name is shown by its row number only. title_sha256 identifies the full printed title. Candidate names are never stored.
label_rule.historical_namesake_kept: party names honouring historical figures who are not candidates are kept as printed: HRVATSKA STRANKA PRAVA DR. ANTE STARČEVIĆ; HRVATSKA SELJAČKA STRANKA - STJEPAN RADIĆ; HRVATSKA SELJAČKA STRANKA BRAĆE RADIĆ

label_rule.independent_list_rule: Independent lists printed as “NEOVISNA LISTA - <list leader>” (2000, 2003 and 2007 decisions) are shown as NEOVISNA LISTA; the leader’s name is not stored. title_sha256 identifies the printed title, so independent lists are never grouped together.
